reconfigure_scene: reconfigure a habitat sim scene with deterministic agent start positions and optional human objects
set_agent_start_position: set the initial agent position and rotation for a specific habitat sim scene by name
add_human_objects: add male and female human objects to supported habitat sim scenes like apartment_0 or skokloster-castle
recompute_navmesh: recompute the navigation mesh including static objects after adding human objects to the scene
load_object_configs: load human male and female object template configs from the test assets directory into the simulator
